name: Create Note in Notes
shellCommand:
osascript -e 'tell application "Notes" to activate' -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 45 using {command down}'
txt=$FREEWAY_TEXT
if [[ "$txt" != "Note." ]]; then
	txt="${txt#Note }"
	zsh -c 'str="${1#Note*(,)[[:space:]]*}"; echo "${str:0:1:u}${str:1}"' -- "$txt"
fi
